Dear Karyna,
Happy Friday! (it's a big day for US and rest of the world!)
Karyna, both Mr. Koga and I are delighted to learn that you would be able to have lunch with us on Sunday, February 5th.
We very much look forward to meeting you in person!
As promised, I am sending you a schedule for your lessons including TOKI arranged lessons/excursions' schedule as well.
Please find attached for your review. (one change; I hope it is acceptable to push back your first manner lesson to 4pm instead
of 2pm due to a vacancy of lesson space)
This is a photo of lesson space (please rest assured that you would not have to be seated on tatami mat for a long time). They
will have a desk/chair.
<image008.jpg>
For the Japanese manner lesson tuition, we, Hyatt Japan to make a bank transfer to the school and will arrange to charge the
cost to your room so that all can be settled by the provided credit card.
Karyna, I have a few things that I would like to go over with you by phone and wonder if I can call you tomorrow morning my
time which would be your Friday evening ie. 8pm/9pm etc. like last time.
Please kindly let me know of your schedule.
Should you have any questions or additional inquiries, please do feel free to let me know at any time.
We are very excited for you!!
Have a wonderful day ahead!
Warmest regards,
Asako
